15.t: Working with data: a breeding puzzle
q: How many young did female 2 have with the white male?
State the genotype of the white male.
Work out the genotypes of female 1 and female 2.
Female 1 BB (no white young). Female 2 Bb (about 1 : 1 with a white male).
Female 1’s son is black. Use the third cross to work out his genotype, with a Punnett square.
His father was bb, so he must be Bb. Bb × Bb gives 3 black : 1 white, which matches 12 : 4.
